caption:
How does AI actually get cheaper and more capable at the same time?

OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar broke down the 'full stack' strategy behind scaling intelligence. It isn't just about training larger models—it requires compounding optimizations across four distinct layers:

1. Silicon & Custom Chips
2. Compute Infrastructure
3. Model Architecture
4. User Products

When all four layers align, the cost per unit of intelligence drops, enabling continuous AI agents rather than single on-demand prompts.
